$Comment: Find the Golden Turkey Trophy (Item/Items/Harvest_Feast/Harvest_Feast_Golden_Turkey_Trophy.json), the
Great Turkey's rarest find: a small roll in its Boss Kill Claim on every win in the Turkey Graveyard,
rolled again in its daily Claim on the first win each day, three times as likely on the hard way in. LOOT_RECEIVED counts the trophy as a payout hands it over,
so it ticks the moment the Claim holding it is collected, from the chest where the Great Turkey fell or
from Claims; it names no Qualifier, so any payout that hands one over counts.
Earned once and kept: no Parent, so no yearly copy, and no full_table tag, since luck decides it. It
